# Epic Breakdown: User Notifications

## Questions I Would Ask (With Assumptions)

1. **What events trigger notifications?** → *Assuming: account changes, system alerts, activity mentions*
2. **Which channels?** → *Assuming: in-app, email, push (mobile)*
3. **User preference control?** → *Assuming: yes, per-channel settings*
4. **Real-time requirement?** → *Assuming: near real-time for in-app, batched for email*
5. **Notification history?** → *Assuming: yes, viewable in-app*

---

## Technical Enabler Stories

### E1: Notification Infrastructure
**Points:** 8

- Set up notification service/queue
- Define notification data model
- Create API endpoints for sending/retrieving notifications
- **No dependencies**

---

## User Stories (Prioritized Order)

### Story 1: In-App Notification Display
*As a user, I want to see notifications in the app, so that I'm aware of important events.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Notification bell icon shows unread count
- Dropdown displays last 20 notifications
- Each notification shows title, message, timestamp
- Clicking notification marks it as read
- Notifications link to relevant content

**Points:** 5 | **Depends on:** E1

---

### Story 2: Email Notifications
*As a user, I want to receive email notifications, so that I stay informed when not in the app.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- System sends emails for high-priority events
- Emails use branded template
- Unsubscribe link included in footer
- Email contains action link to relevant app page

**Points:** 3 | **Depends on:** E1

---

### Story 3: Notification Preferences
*As a user, I want to control my notification settings, so that I only receive relevant alerts.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Settings page shows all notification types
- Toggle on/off per channel (in-app, email, push)
- Changes save immediately
- Default preferences set for new users

**Points:** 5 | **Depends on:** Story 1, Story 2

---

### Story 4: Mark All As Read
*As a user, I want to mark all notifications as read, so that I can clear my notification list quickly.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- "Mark all read" button in notification dropdown
- Bulk update clears unread count
- Action is undoable for 5 seconds

**Points:** 2 | **Depends on:** Story 1

---

### Story 5: Mobile Push Notifications
*As a mobile user, I want push notifications, so that I receive alerts without opening the app.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Push sent for enabled notification types
- Tapping push opens relevant app screen
- Works on iOS and Android
- Respects user preference settings

**Points:** 5 | **Depends on:** E1, Story 3

---

### Story 6: Notification History Page
*As a user, I want to view my notification history, so that I can find past alerts.*

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Dedicated page shows all notifications
- Filterable by read/unread status
- Paginated (20 per page)
- Notifications older than 90 days auto-deleted

**Points:** 3 | **Depends on:** Story 1

---

## Sprint Planning

**Sprint 1 (19 pts):** E1 (8) + Story 1 (5) + Story 2 (3) + Story 4 (2)
**Sprint 2 (13 pts):** Story 3 (5) + Story 5 (5) + Story 6 (3)
